Hi Karthik — thanks for the recap, this is helpful. A few answers below: 

- Procurement route: For pilots under $25k we typically allow card. Anything above that goes through AP with a PO raised in Coupa. For multi-quarter contracts we prefer a PO.
- Billing/contact info: Invoices need to be made out to BrightForge Inc., remit to: BrightForge Accounts Payable, 210 Harbor Drive, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401. Please include our tax ID on the invoice (I can provide it once we confirm vendor setup).
- Net terms: Our standard is net-60 but we can do net-45 for initial pilot approvals on a case-by-case basis. Will need that in writing on the SOW/PO.
- Marketplace & vendor portals: We do use Coupa and we evaluate marketplace vendors, but this procurement would prefer a direct PO + invoice unless Redwood is already in Coupa or on AWS Marketplace. Are you listed on AWS Marketplace? If not, how long to get vendor info into Coupa?

I'll kick this to AP to request a vendor form and W-9/EIN from you. If you can provide your W-9 and a short vendor pack (remittance, W-9, bank details), that will speed setup.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Jensen
